requirements.summary: Remove gallery description truncation and ensure safe multi-line wrapping for public, admin, and featured gallery cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Gallery descriptions are no longer limited to 2 lines anywhere they are displayed.
Very long descriptions render fully (multi-line) without being visually cut off.
Long unbroken strings do not overflow the card layout (they wrap/break safely).

file_operations.description: Update featured gallery card description rendering to remove any truncation classes (e.g., line-clamp) and apply multi-line wrapping with safe word-breaking and line-break preservation (e.g., whitespace-pre-wrap + break-words) so very long descriptions display fully.

Update public gallery card description rendering to remove truncation (e.g., line-clamp) and ensure descriptions wrap across multiple lines with safe word-breaking and preserved line breaks so long/paragraph text and unbroken strings do not overflow.

Update admin gallery management card description rendering (and any other gallery description previews in this page) to remove truncation and ensure full multi-line rendering with safe word-breaking and preserved line breaks.

requirements.summary: Make all description editing inputs comfortable for long multi-paragraph text and remove any client-side length limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Admins can paste/type long descriptions (multiple paragraphs) into description fields and save successfully.
No description input field enforces a small/short maximum length via the UI.

file_operations.description: Ensure all description editing inputs in FeaturedGallery (edit description dialog and upload description field) use multiline Textarea with comfortable sizing (more rows/min-height and optional resize) and verify there is no maxLength or other UI-enforced limit that blocks long descriptions.

Ensure the gallery description edit dialog input uses a multiline Textarea sized for long text entry (rows/min-height, optional resize) and verify there is no maxLength or other UI-enforced limit for description editing.

Ensure all description editing inputs in gallery management (edit description dialog and upload description field) use multiline Textarea sized for long multi-paragraph entry (rows/min-height, optional resize) and verify there is no maxLength or other UI-enforced limit.
